verses.english: It’s too cold, too hot, too late in the evening— people who say this, shirking their work: The moment passes them by. Whoever regards cold & heat as no more than grass, doing his manly duties, won’t fall away from ease. With my chest I push through wild grasses— spear-grass, ribbon-grass, rushes— cultivating a heart bent on seclusion.
